## The seeded defects

| name | what was broken |
|---|---|
| `accept_stale_term` | messages from an older term are processed instead of rejected |
| `commit_any_term` | a leader commits an entry as soon as a majority stores it, even if the entry is from an earlier term (the Figure 8 bug) |
| `commit_index_unclamped` | a follower sets commitIndex to leaderCommit without clamping it to the last entry it actually has |
| `ignore_prev_log_term` | the AppendEntries consistency check compares only the index, not the term (silent log divergence) |
| `no_log_up_to_date_check` | grant a vote without checking the candidate's log is at least as up to date (violates Leader Completeness) |
| `no_persist_voted_for` | votedFor is not persisted, so a node can vote twice in one term after a crash (two leaders in the same term) |
| `no_step_down_on_higher_term` | a leader seeing a higher term keeps leading |
| `truncate_on_every_append` | a follower truncates its log at prevLogIndex on every AppendEntries, even when the entries already match (drops committed entries) |
